summary.text: Steve Vetter is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 18 (Grand Forks), serving since 2017. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Judiciary, where he is vice chair, and Government and Veterans Affairs.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Vetter is a real property appraiser with a BS in business administration and organizational leadership from the University of Mary.
In the interim he is vice chair of the Judiciary Committee and serves on the Employee Benefits Programs Committee.
